correctness.rationale: For each connected finite simple cactus and every finite abelian palette H of order q>=3, simultaneous colour translation forces unbalanced Fourier frequencies to zero. At a one-vertex block amalgamation balanced frequencies factor uniquely and W_G=q^{-1}W_{G1}W_{G2}; induction over the block-cut tree gives one global q factor and independent bridge/cycle lists. A bridge has normalized multiplier list (q−1,−1,...,−1). Fourier expansion of unequal-colour indicators on a cycle gives the pinned-potential list ((−1)^ell/q)sum_a(1−q)^{m_a}, integer by mod q. A zero satisfies sum_{a=1}^q(−(q−1))^{m_a}=0; divide by its minimum exponent and reduce modulo q−1>=2: precisely q−1 terms attain the minimum and the one other must be exactly one exponent higher. Thus length ell=qt+1, t>=1, with exactly ell!/[(t+1)!(t!)^(q−1)] pinned zeros. The rank product q^e∏(q^(ell_j−1)−Z_q(ell_j)) follows. Independently enumerated all Fourier transforms of q3 C3/C4, q4 C4/C5, q5 C6: extra balanced zeros 12,60,360 and ranks 15,196,2765, matching theorem. Finite tests do not replace the block and occupancy proofs.
residual_risks: The q=3 and q=4 cycle corollaries are known; cannot claim their individual novelty.
